fato_historico: 1741: The eruption of Oshima–Ōshima and the Kampo tsunami: At least 2,000 people along the Japanese coast drown in a tsunami caused by the eruption of Oshima.

Just as nature reminds us of its immense strength, you are encouraged to channel your intensity toward healing and transformation. Consider this a beautiful time to release old tensions and let your natural resilience flow like calm, steady waves toward a brighter horizon.
frase_do_dia: Even the mightiest tides eventually turn, carrying us toward new and peaceful beginnings.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing spiritual awakening and the promise of future luck.
conselho: Trust the natural rhythm of life and stay open to unexpected, positive changes today.
